Lessons.Title: Randomness in Groups
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Comprehend (in spoken and written language) what it means to be random in the context of statistics. Explain (orally and in writing) what it means to select at random.

Simple random selection gives every possible sample of a specified size an equal chance (under the stated scheme). Random selection supports generalization; random assignment supports causal comparison. Neither means choosing convenient participants.
